From the owner
Home Wellness Spaces: Gyms, Saunas & Relaxation Rooms Home design has increasingly shifted toward spaces that support wellness, balance, and everyday comfort. For many Twin Cities homeowners, remodeling is no longer focused solely on aesthetics or entertaining. Instead, homeowners are investing in spaces that improve how they feel and function day to day. From home gyms and saunas to quiet relaxation rooms and spa-inspired lower levels, wellness-centered remodeling has become one of the fastest-growing trends in residential design. In Minneapolis and St. Paul, where long winters encourage more time spent indoors, homeowners are creating personalized wellness spaces that bring convenience, comfort, and restoration into the home itself.
